arStrings.szText: "I feel it channeling Horadric power through me."
So this thing converts Horadric relics into power. We can use it to break down the blood relics. It won’t get rid of the blood, but it’ll contain it. For now.
Why don’t you practice with that new power? And I’ll dig up some of Donan’s old notes. Maybe they’ll help us purge the blood—for good, this time.
